# UNINSTALL, MODELS) and its Legacy Metal issue (#1008, issues listed for macOS 13 and not marked fixed since), and
# reports from people testing OCLP 3.0 with Tahoe (MacRumors "macOS Tahoe 26 on unsupported Macs" thread).

column3: iPhone Mirroring won't open: it needs Apple's T2 chip, which this Mac doesn't have.
Apple Intelligence (Writing Tools, Genmoji, Image Playground) won't appear: it needs an Apple silicon chip.
Each macOS update (for example 15.6 to 15.7) downloads the whole installer, about 12 GB, instead of an update of about 3 GB.
After each macOS update, the screen runs without graphics acceleration (slow, choppy animations, no transparency) until TLA BootPaper puts the patches back, which takes one more restart.
If OpenCore is ever removed from this Mac, it won't start up (it shows a circle with a line through it) until macOS is reinstalled from a USB installer.
Tahoe comes from OpenCore Legacy Patcher 3.0.0-rc.5, a release candidate: its makers haven't published their list of what doesn't work on Tahoe yet.
People testing earlier 3.0 versions reported that the Mac didn't go to sleep, and that the time zone couldn't be changed by hand (Location Services kept setting it).
On 2016 and 2017 MacBook Pros with a Touch Bar, people testing earlier 3.0 versions reported that Touch ID and Wi-Fi didn't work.
Zoom won't open without a separate fix.
Apps can't ask for the camera or microphone, so Zoom and Teams can't use them unless permission is given another way.
Menus and sidebars with a blurred background look smeared when the pointer moves over them.
Safari extensions can't be turned on.
When editing a widget in the sidebar, the Done button can't be clicked.
Maps doesn't work, and neither does what relies on it: Find My, and Places in Photos.
Firefox and Thunderbird can freeze the whole Mac unless their hardware acceleration is turned off.
The Weather app quits when you scroll to the bottom of its list.
QuickTime Player shows green blocks along the timeline of .mov videos.
Memoji freezes or quits, so a Memoji can't be used as your account picture.
Memoji freezes or quits, so a Memoji can't be used as your account picture.
Screen recordings of part of the screen come out with garbled areas (recording the whole screen works).
The Photos app won't open.
The screensaver quits as soon as it starts.
The camera shows a black picture.

The built-in keyboard, trackpad and Bluetooth don't work after installing (and after each macOS update) until the patches are put back, so a USB keyboard and mouse, plugged in through a USB hub, are needed until then.
